sources.supported_scope: 17 October 2017 collision on SS280 in Lamezia Terme; road homicide and driving under the influence allegations; later precautionary measure
death following injuries from the 17 October collision

supported_facts: The collision occurred on 17 October 2017 on SS280 in the municipality of Lamezia Terme and involved multiple vehicles.
The official source describes alleged road homicide and driving under the influence arising from the same driving/collision transaction.
A seriously injured participant later died; contemporaneous local reporting records the death on 5 November 2017.
The later precautionary measure is procedural history, not a new EVENT.

event_identity_analysis.rationale: The alleged driving conduct and collision form one continuous transaction. Multiple legal offences and a later death outcome do not create multiple criminal EVENT identities.

temporal_analysis.caution: Store death as a later outcome/assertion; never replace the occurrence date with the death or arrest date.

geography_analysis.more_specific_context: Sant'Eufemia/SS280 access area reported by contemporaneous secondary coverage

reported_families: driving under the influence of alcohol
offence_analysis.preferred_modelling: multiple offence instances attached to one event

recommended_resolution: One discrete EVENT with multiple offence instances and a separate later death/outcome assertion. Suitable for reviewed-bundle preparation after human review of geography and public wording.
publication_blockers: Human review required for road-segment precision and outcome wording before approved bundle status.
